comments:
In spite of the editorial title on the cover page of instance (ID:4776) identifying it as a commentary on the Pramāṇa­vārttika­ (ID:3772), this work belongs rather to the category of summaries. 
It was composed after 1219, as it refers to the Tshad ma rigs gter (ID:5564). See [J4L5X9AG]: 434.
It also addresses the views of a number of Indian commentators and anonymous opponents, including some referred to as "Tibetans" (bod kha cig), and refers with name to rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786), Khyung (ID:3809), rGya dmar ba (ID:3834), Phya pa (ID:3831), as well as Klu mes (ID:7964).
